# Hypothesis Testing


## Notes

```
pnorm(x) = y # percentage
# Quantile
x = qnorm(y) # z score
```

* We use $H_0 = a$ and $ H_1 < a $ or $H_1 > a$ style.

* Decide the value $ x < a $  that even if this is by chance, the value is far from expected value.
* The percentage of type II error describes the possibility that we might miss the violated one.  


## Tutorial 3
**Left Side**

```{r}
v0 <- 355
sd_x <- 6
n <- 5
alpha <- 0.05
se <- sqrt(sd_x / n)

z <- qnorm(alpha)
c_val <- v0 + z * se
cat(sprintf("Critical Value: %.3f\n", c_val))

T_obs <- 353
reject <- T_obs < c_val
if (reject){
    cat(sprintf("Reject H0 for T=353: %s\n", reject))
}else{
    # Do not use approve here
    cat(sprintf("Failed to reject H0 for T=353: %s\n", reject))
}
v_true_mean <- 354
# P(T > c_val | v = 354)
beta <- 1 - pnorm(c_val, mean = v_true_mean, sd = se)
cat(sprintf("Probability of Type II Error: %.4f\n", beta))
```

## Tutorial 4

**Right Side**

```{r}
v0 <- 10
sd_x <- 4
n <- 7
alpha <- 1 - 0.05
se <- sqrt(sd_x / n)

z <- qnorm(alpha)
c_val <- v0 + z * se
cat(sprintf("Critical Value: %.3f\n", c_val))

T_obs <- 10.5
reject <- T_obs > c_val
if (reject){
    cat(sprintf("Reject H0 for T=10.5: %s\n", reject))
}else{
    cat(sprintf("Failed to reject H0 for T=10.5: %s\n", reject))
}
v_true_mean <- 10.2
# P(T > c_val | v = 10.2)
beta <- 1 - pnorm(c_val, mean = v_true_mean, sd = se)
cat(sprintf("Probability of Type II Error: %.4f\n", beta))

```

## Tutorial 5

**Both Side**

```{r}
v0 <- 10
sd_x <- 1.5 * 1.5
n <- 9
alpha <- 0.01
se <- sqrt(sd_x / n)

qnorm(1 - alpha/2)
c_val_higher <- v0 + z * se
c_val_lower <- v0 - z * se

cat(sprintf("Critical Values: Lower=%.3f, Higher=%.3f\n", c_val_lower, c_val_higher))

T_obs <- 97.2
reject <- T_obs > c_val_higher | T_obs < c_val_lower
if (reject){
    cat(sprintf("Reject H0 for T=%.1f: %s\n", T_obs, reject))
}else{
    cat(sprintf("Fail to reject H0 for T=%.1f: %s\n", T_obs, reject))
}
v_true_mean <- 97.2
# P(T > c_val | v = v')
beta <- 1 - pnorm(c_val, mean = v_true_mean, sd = se)
cat(sprintf("Probability of Type II Error: %.4f\n", beta))

```
